description: The presentation's saved versions. Each one's folder, `versions/<number>/`, holds copies of the presentation's two files as they were saved: `slides.md`, and the .mdpoint file as `presentation.json`, so the folder is never a presentation of its own. A numbered folder holding both files is a version even where the catalog doesn't list it, saved when its files last changed. A version names its theme by key and shows the theme as it is now. It uses the presentation's own media. Delete Theme refuses a theme a version uses, and Clean Up keeps a file one uses. While a version's folder holds only some of its files, or a listed version's folder isn't there, as while a sync service brings it, no theme can be deleted and Clean Up deletes nothing. A catalog that can't be read is never written over, so no version is saved until it reads.

markdownpoint.description: The format version, its major and minor in quotes: "1.0". MarkdownPoint 1.x opens any version 1.x file. A newer major needs a newer MarkdownPoint.

next.description: The least number the next version takes; MarkdownPoint goes past every number listed or found, so a deleted version's number is never given again.

number.description: Its number, the name of its folder in versions.

saved.description: When it was saved, in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ.

name.description: The name the author gave it, on one line, not empty, with no tab or other control character, or none when left out.

versions.description: The versions it lists, each a saved-version record, or none when left out.
